title: TagDuel training creation transaction atomicity
scenarios: A SQLite trigger aborts INSERT into tag_sessions during createTagTraining. The transaction must leave no orphan session and no owner lock; after removing the trigger, retry creates one playing training session and one human lock.

A SQLite trigger aborts INSERT into tag_members after the training session row has been inserted. The transaction must roll back the session row and lock together; retry creates exactly one session and one human lock.
invariants: Training session and human participant lock are created atomically.
A failed createTagTraining leaves the preexisting sessions and locks byte-for-byte unchanged.
Only the human owner receives a global tag_members lock; NPC seats do not create player locks.
Player rows and player_cards remain unchanged; training decks remain ephemeral.
Successful training state has unique physical card UIDs.
limits: Tests use temporary SQLite and real compiled TagStore/TagDuel modules.
Fault injection covers SQL trigger aborts, not process termination or filesystem corruption.
No runtime, resolver, catalog manifest, allowlist, persistent database or player data is modified.
This is a training-session persistence regression and certifies no new card behavior.
No live Discord API session is performed.
command: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/tagTrainingCreationAtomicity2v2.test.cjs
